subject: Post-call recap: Pricing & token volumes — confirm budget owner
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khanna <samir.k@finex.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: Pricing & token volumes — confirm budget owner

Thanks again for the time this morning — good conversation and lots of alignment. Quick recap + a few asks so we can turn this into a firm estimate and MAP:

Recap
- Primary workload: customer support & content moderation inference (realtime chat + batched daily jobs)
- Estimated usage: ~1.2B tokens / month (peaks to ~1.6B in Q4)
- Target unit economics discussed: target $/1M tokens ~ $900 (you mentioned flexibility toward $800 with an annual commit)
- Rough budget range mentioned on call: $150k–$250k annually for initial year-of-production costs

Asks / next steps
1) Please confirm the economic buyer and the budget owner for pricing/contract sign-off so we can route approvals correctly.
2) Can finance confirm whether there is a formal procurement window or specific PO cadence (Net30/Net45)?
3) I attached an initial pricing estimate (redwood-pricing-estimate-v1.pdf) and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) for your review — if you can flag gaps, we'll update.

If you confirm the stakeholders I'll have Aditya pull together a formal revised estimate with the $/1M tokens options (annual commit vs monthly) plus a two-tier SLA bucket for Dedicated vs Hosted.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: redwood-pricing-estimate-v1.pdf
Attachment: mutual-action-plan-Finex.xlsx

From: Samir Khanna <samir.k@finex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyanka Shah <pri@finex.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Pricing & token volumes — confirm budget owner

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few confirmations from our side:

- Confirmed token volumes: the 1.2B/month number is correct for Q1 production planning; Q4 peaks are expected as noted.
- Economic buyer: Anika Bose (Head of Data & ML) — she will need the unit economics and payer-level ROI written up.
- Budget owner / approver for this investment: Priyanka Shah (Head of Engineering Ops) — she owns the cloud/infra line that will fund this. I've cc'd Priyanka here.
- Finance sign-off: CFO office indicates they can review and sign within 1–2 weeks after we receive a formal estimate + MAP; target the week of Nov 29 for final approval.

On pricing: Anika said the target is around $900 / 1M tokens but they're looking for a priced option at $800 / 1M with a 12-month commitment (we mentioned committed throughput and some caching/optimizations). Please send an updated estimate showing both options (monthly vs annual commit) and highlight RU/token assumptions.

Also: Priyanka asked for an itemized run-rate so finance can model the spend against their SRE budget.

Samir
Samir Khanna
Director, Platform Engineering — Finex Corp
samir.k@finex.com | +1 (212) 555-0112

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Aditya / Neha — forwarding Samir's confirmations. Please prioritize an updated estimate that includes:
- Option A: $900 / 1M tokens (monthly, no commit) — show monthly invoices and projected monthly spend at 1.2B tokens
- Option B: $800 / 1M tokens (12-month commit) — include any startup credits or ramp schedule we can offer
- Itemized run-rate for finance (tokens, average sequence length assumptions, concurrency, estimated cost savings from prefix caching)

Attach the revised PDF + an updated MAP. Samir wants finance to be able to model the spend; Priyanka expects to see an itemized run-rate. Target to send back to Finex by COB Thu, Nov 19.

Thanks — Marissa

(On behalf of Redwood Pricing)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Updated pricing estimate + MAP (Finex)

Samir / Priyanka — attaching an updated estimate and revised MAP per Marissa's notes. High-level summary below and attachments: redwood-pricing-estimate-v2.pdf, mutual-action-plan-Finex.xlsx

Summary
- Volume: 1.2B tokens / month (baseline)
- Option A (No commit): $900 / 1M tokens — est. monthly cost: $1,080,000 (1.2B / 1M * $900)
- Option B (12-month commit): $800 / 1M tokens — est. monthly cost: $960,000; projected annual spend: ~$11.52M; we included a staged ramp and 2% onboarding credit in the MAP
- Itemized run-rate included (tokens, avg seq len = 120 tokens, concurrency assumptions, cache hit rate 15%)

Next steps
1) Please confirm Priyanka is comfortable as budget owner and whether finance needs a PO template (we can provide).
2) If Anika wants a short ROI note for the economic buyer, we can produce a 1-page ROI that ties expected latency improvements to operational savings.
3) DocuSign-ready SOW/Order Form available once stakeholders sign off.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-estimate-v2.pdf; mutual-action-plan-Finex.xlsx

— Aditya Rao
